title: Arizer V-Tower Vaporizer with Free Cyclone Bowl (taxes extra)
description:
The V-Tower is easy to use, very efficient and tastes great.

The first desktop vaporizer released by Arizer, the V-Tower has passed the test of time. A simple and reliable vaporizer, the V-Tower is a great choice for anyone looking for a basic glass whip vaporizer.

Features:
Digital Temperature Control
All Glass Pathway (tube excepted)
Ceramic Heater

Bonus Item: Free Cyclone Bowl ($15 value)

Included in the kit:
– 3 Foot Whip
– Cyclone Bowl
– Aromatherapy / Potpourri Bowl
– Extra Screens
– Glass Stirring Tool
– Manual
– 2 Year Warranty

Warranty Information
